description: You have decided to relocate your house to the famed town of Tarth Fa Dathrun. Purchase a Housing Deed from your local NPC Vendor to complete the purchase, she can be found in Guild City near the fountain.
name: Tarth Fa Dathrun Home
completed: Return to the NPC Broker in front of your future house in Tarth Fa Dathrun to complete the transaction.
